ddl.name: rules_amount_bounds_check
ddl.value: ("min_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "min_amount_minor" >= 0) AND ("max_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "max_amount_minor" >= 0) AND ("min_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "max_amount_minor" IS NULL OR "min_amount_minor" <= "max_amount_minor")

ddl.name: rules_target_check
ddl.value: ("kind" = 'categorize' AND "category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "client_payee_id" IS NULL AND "counterpart_profile_id" IS NULL AND "obligation_kind" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'income_client' AND "client_payee_id" IS NOT NULL AND "category_id" IS NULL AND "counterpart_profile_id" IS NULL AND "obligation_kind" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'tax_payment' AND "obligation_kind" IS NOT NULL AND "category_id" IS NULL AND "client_payee_id" IS NULL AND "counterpart_profile_id" IS NULL) OR ("kind" = 'self_transfer' AND "category_id" IS NULL AND "client_payee_id" IS NULL AND "obligation_kind" IS NULL) OR ("kind" IN ('refund', 'internal_transfer', 'exclude') AND "category_id" IS NULL AND "client_payee_id" IS NULL AND "counterpart_profile_id" IS NULL AND "obligation_kind" IS NULL)

ddl.name: run_logs_failure_tag_check
ddl.value: ("outcome" = 'Succeeded' AND "failure_tag" IS NULL) OR ("outcome" = 'Failed' AND "failure_tag" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: transactions_suggested_check
ddl.value: "categorization" <> 'suggested' OR ("suggestion_model" IS NOT NULL AND "suggested_at" IS NOT NULL)

ddl.name: transactions_rate_check
ddl.value: ("source_currency" = "base_currency" AND "source_currency" GLOB '[A-Z][A-Z][A-Z]' AND "rate" IS NULL AND "rate_as_of" IS NULL) OR ("source_currency" <> "base_currency" AND "rate" > 0 AND "rate_as_of" IS NOT NULL)
